title: Aspect: a first distinction
subtitle: Present and aorist view action differently.
overview: Present forms normally present an action as ongoing, repeated, or in progress; aorist forms view it as a whole. Aspect is not a stopwatch.
Begin with the contrast before making translation choices such as “was doing” versus “did.”

sections.title: Two viewpoints
rows: he or she writes / is writing — present viewpoint
he or she wrote — aorist viewpoint
